ValidationRule.description: CSC/COC/CPC Communicatior/Supervisor/SuperUser/Leader/Manager/Bottler HQ should be allowed to close the case and other users should be restricted from doing the same.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND (NOT(OR( CONTAINS ($UserRole.Name ,'CCJC CIC Manager'), CONTAINS( $UserRole.Name ,'Bottler HQ'), CONTAINS($Profile.Name ,'CCJC CIC COC User'),CONTAINS($Profile.Name ,'CCJC CIC CSC User') ,CONTAINS($Profile.Name ,'CCJC CIC CPC User'),CONTAINS($Profile.Name ,'System Admin'),CONTAINS($Profile.Name ,'Nexus Data Loader'),CONTAINS($Profile.Name, 'CCJC CIC Multi User') )),ISPICKVAL(Status ,"Closed"),ISPICKVAL(Country_Code__c,'JP'))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You don't have permission to close the case.
